episodes.title: A Long Time Coming
episodes.summary: When a costumed crew pulls off a brazen Halloween heist, LAPD detective Isaiah Stiles begins to suspect it's anything but a one-off crime.

episodes.title: Breaking Protocol
episodes.summary: Stiles assembles a task force to investigate the recent robberies. With the LAPD on alert, Coltrane works to tie up loose ends.

episodes.title: Tête-À-Tête
episodes.summary: Convinced he's identified the crew's ringleader, Stiles races to produce hard evidence. Charlie urges Ebony to cover her bases.

episodes.title: It Was a Good Day
episodes.summary: Coltrane's team takes on a high-stakes job for a volatile client. Stiles puts pressure on a key suspect. Candace leans on Ebony's friendship.

episodes.title: Business. Never Personal.
episodes.summary: Emboldened by a break in the case, Stiles strikes at the heart of the Wilder home. Coltrane plots a devious revenge strategy.

episodes.title: The Die Is Cast
episodes.summary: Stiles and Coltrane face off in an explosive confrontation. A painful revelation prompts Stiles to pursue a new target.

episodes.title: Repercussions
episodes.summary: The Stiles family is rocked by a violent act that implicates Isaiah — and Noah. Sick of sitting on the sidelines, Ebony takes control of the narrative.

episodes.title: Zugzwang
episodes.summary: With his options running out, Coltrane stages a bold extraction plan. Stiles makes a last-ditch effort to corner his adversary once and for all.
